Indonesia: Thousands fall ill from suspected food poisoning in school meals

Nearly 2,000 people, primarily students, have fallen ill in suspected food poisoning incidents linked to Indonesia's Free Nutritious Meals program. The outbreaks occurred between September 1 and September 3. These incidents represent a setback for the program, which has been implemented across the archipelago despite prior food poisoning events and corruption allegations.
